description: This Java class defines configuration properties for the AMQP protocol adapter, including default values and getter/setter methods for frame size, session frames, and idle timeout.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties for the AMQP protocol adapter, extending ProtocolAdapterProperties, including settings for frame size, session frames, and idle timeout.

methods.name: getMaxFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bytes that can be be sent in an AMQP message delivery.

methods.name: setMaxFrameSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bytes that can be sent in an AMQP message delivery, with validation for minimum size.

methods.name: getMaxSessionFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of transfer frames for sessions created on this connection.

methods.name: setMaxSessionFrames
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of transfer frames for sessions, with validation for minimum value.

methods.name: getMaxSessionWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the product of maxFrameSize and maxSessionFrames, representing the session window size.

methods.name: setIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout in milliseconds for detecting stale connections, with validation for non-negative values.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current idle timeout in milliseconds.
